You are the construction_batch_specialist and own this single bounded SAMPO historical-construction label-mapping batch end-to-end. Execute the complete workflow yourself: prescribed multi-retriever retrieval, deterministic partition by top-1 disagreement, selective semantic review, and non-overlapping durable prediction writes. Do not split or defer the unit.

IDENTIFIERS / CONTEXT
- run_id: NOT explicitly present in the delegated context. Acknowledge this; use the run_id supplied by your harness/artifact store if one exists and report which value you used. If no run_id can be resolved, treat this as a pre-persistence blocker and report it explicitly rather than inventing one.
- artifact_id (retrieval evidence, already confirmed present): 6983eedefb48c433fc5759b7c78247c08d38ecfd2f915ddd361b84d0c26fd241
- batch offset: NOT explicitly supplied. If your harness provides an offset/partition, use it; otherwise state the offset you assumed (e.g., batch starting at the first assigned ID) in your report.
- assigned example IDs for this unit (from prior evidence retrieval on the artifact above): 973, 10779, 628, 7152, 10667, 5604, 507, 8687, 2305. Confirm this set against the actual assigned batch; if the harness assigned a different/overlapping set, report the mismatch explicitly and proceed only within the assigned unit.

MANDATORY RETRIEVAL CONSTRAINT
- Use the exact prescribed multi-retriever set (bm25_token, char_tfidf, char_word_fusion, construction_token_tfidf, word_tfidf) against the artifact above; do not substitute retrievers or re-rank by hand outside the deterministic fusion already produced.

MANDATORY PARTITION CONSTRAINT
- Partition deterministically by top-1 disagreement (i.e., cases where retrievers disagree on the top candidate / no single confident top-1). Apply the partition rule identically across all assigned IDs; do not hand-pick which IDs get reviewed.

MANDATORY REVIEW CONSTRAINT
- Perform selective semantic review only for the disagreement-partitioned cases. For each reviewed case, select the best label from the fused candidate list (or an explicitly justified allowed label), and record a short rationale. Do not review or override cases that fall outside the disagreement partition.

MANDATORY PERSISTENCE CONSTRAINT
- Write predictions durably, non-overlapping with any other batch/agent. One prediction per assigned example_id; no duplicate keys. Do not persist partial or speculative rows. Confirm the write is durable before reporting success.

REPORTING
- On success, return a COMPACT completion report: run_id used, artifact_id, batch offset assumed/used, number of assigned IDs, partition counts (consensus vs disagreement), number reviewed, number persisted, and the durable write location/identifier.
- On any pre-persistence failure or unresolved unit, report the failure status faithfully and stop — do not invent predictions or switch workflows.
